usage: llm-modelbench repair [-h] (--run-id RUN_ID | --run-prefix RUN_PREFIX |
                             --everything) [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR]
                             [--rankings-out RANKINGS_OUT]
                             [--plan-out PLAN_OUT] [--apply | --dry-run]
                             [--yes] [--judge {off,single,panel}]
                             [--judge-model JUDGE_MODEL]
                             [--num-predict NUM_PREDICT]
                             [--no-transient-retry] [--no-missing-tasks]
                             [--emergency-headroom-gb EMERGENCY_HEADROOM_GB]
                             [--max-spill-gb MAX_SPILL_GB]
                             [--kv-type {current,q8_0,q4_0}]
                             [--gpu-vram-gb GPU_VRAM_GB] [--confirm-kv-server]
                             [--kv-cascade] [--restart-ollama]
                             [--ollama-service OLLAMA_SERVICE]
                             [--keep-final-kv] [--reuse-sudo-credentials]
                             [--auto-confirm] [--force]
                             [--live-ui {off,compact,full,log}] [--mock]
                             [--runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE]
                             [--no-ranking-update] [--separate-ranking]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run-id RUN_ID       repair one run under --runs-dir
  --run-prefix RUN_PREFIX
                        repair every run whose ID starts with this prefix
  --everything          scan every run under --runs-dir
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR
  --rankings-out RANKINGS_OUT
                        rankings directory refreshed after --apply; default:
                        rankings
  --plan-out PLAN_OUT   write the repair plan JSON to this path
  --apply               execute the printed bounded repair plan
  --dry-run             explicitly request planning only; this is also the
                        default when --apply is omitted
  --yes                 approve the printed repair plan in non-interactive
                        execution
  --judge {off,single,panel}
                        post-hoc judge eligible subjective dumps as part of
                        repair
  --judge-model JUDGE_MODEL
                        local Ollama judge model
  --num-predict NUM_PREDICT
                        bounded output budget for thinking-only/empty-output
                        recovery
  --no-transient-retry  report HTTP 5xx/timeouts but do not schedule one retry
  --no-missing-tasks    repair only explicit failed rows, not absent/stale
                        applicable tasks
  --emergency-headroom-gb EMERGENCY_HEADROOM_GB
                        physical VRAM kept free during guarded needle planning
  --max-spill-gb MAX_SPILL_GB
                        maximum estimated system-RAM spill permitted for
                        guarded needle retries
  --kv-type {current,q8_0,q4_0}
                        required Ollama KV-cache type for needle repair;
                        explicit values require server setup/restart
  --gpu-vram-gb GPU_VRAM_GB
                        override detected physical GPU VRAM for offline
                        planning or unusual drivers
  --confirm-kv-server   assert that the running Ollama service was restarted
                        with --kv-type when process environment cannot be
                        inspected
  --kv-cascade          current/default-KV first; use q8_0 then unresolved-
                        only q4_0 only for remaining guarded needle work
  --restart-ollama      allow the explicit KV cascade to install a temporary
                        systemd drop-in and restart Ollama
  --ollama-service OLLAMA_SERVICE
                        deprecated display hint; the privileged broker always
                        discovers the sole Ollama unit owning the configured
                        port
  --keep-final-kv       do not restore the original Ollama service drop-in
                        after the cascade
  --reuse-sudo-credentials
                        do not invalidate sudo's cached timestamp before each
                        privileged phase
  --auto-confirm        fully unattended apply mode for --restart-ollama --kv-
                        cascade: implies --yes, skips typed
                        DISCOVER/VERIFY/RESTART confirmations, and uses sudo
                        -n only. Requires a scoped NOPASSWD sudoers rule for
                        the dedicated broker in docs/auto_confirm_sudoers.md.
                        Does not store or read a password. Off by default.
  --force               allow a previously recorded repair action to be
                        planned again
  --live-ui {off,compact,full,log}
                        inline repair-aware dashboard for child runs; detached
                        llmb-watch remains supported
  --mock                offline deterministic repair pipeline test
  --runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE
                        saved runtime profile; explicit selection takes
                        precedence
  --no-ranking-update   write repair evidence but skip automatic rankings
                        refresh
  --separate-ranking    generate an isolated rankings-separate/<plan-id>
                        report for repair children
